name: unity-controller
description: Edit scenes, objects, built-in components, prefabs, data assets, materials, textures, cameras, meshes, animation clips and controllers, VFX, physics, rendering and UI in a selected external Unity project. Supports scene repair, undo/redo, clearing logs, project-local captures and batches of 20. Returns selected project numbers, IDs and flags. Blocks documents, Blender, host network and application queries, external services and arbitrary code. See the operation list for individual actions.

settings.title: Unity project hash or Name@hash
settings.description: Copy the project hash from unity_controller_instances. An existing exact Name@hash remains valid.
